errors.agent_cpu_over_max: kuberuntime: agent cpu limit {limit} exceeds the tenant per-container max {max} (OCTOPUS_TENANT_LIMIT_MAX_CPU)
errors.agent_memory_over_max: kuberuntime: agent memory limit {limit} exceeds the tenant per-container max {max} (OCTOPUS_TENANT_LIMIT_MAX_MEMORY)
errors.agent_over_quota: kuberuntime: an agent pod asks {resource}={value}, more than the whole tenant quota {total} ({env}); no agent could ever launch
errors.browser_cpu_over_max: kuberuntime: per-run browser cpu limit {limit} ({env}) exceeds the tenant per-container max {max} (OCTOPUS_TENANT_LIMIT_MAX_CPU)
errors.browser_memory_over_max: kuberuntime: per-run browser memory limit {limit} ({env}) exceeds the tenant per-container max {max} (OCTOPUS_TENANT_LIMIT_MAX_MEMORY)
errors.bind_tenant_secrets: kuberuntime: bind {role} in {ns}: {cause} (the daemon needs rolebindings create and bind on that ClusterRole, as in deploy/helm/octopus/templates/rbac.yaml)
errors.control_plane_port_range: kuberuntime: control-plane port {port} out of range
errors.egress_entry_bad_port: kuberuntime: egress allow entry {entry:%q}: bad port {port:%q}
errors.egress_entry_not_ip: kuberuntime: egress allow entry {entry:%q}: not an IP or CIDR
errors.env_var_name_invalid: kuberuntime: env var {name:%q} cannot be stored in a Secret (allowed: letters, digits, '-', '_', '.')
errors.get_chat_pod: kuberuntime: get chat pod {ns}/{pod} for exec service
errors.label_namespace_forbidden: kuberuntime: namespace {name} lacks its Pod Security / tenant labels and the daemon may not update namespaces — grant the daemon's ClusterRole `update` on namespaces, or label it by hand
errors.launch_ids_required: kuberuntime: launch needs WorkspaceID, TaskID and InstanceID (got {workspace:%q}/{task:%q}/{instance:%q})
errors.launch_workspace_required: kuberuntime: no workspace to launch into (workspace id is empty)
errors.namespace_template_placeholder: kuberuntime: namespace template {template:%q} has no %s placeholder
errors.no_image: kuberuntime: no image in spec and none configured: set {env}
errors.pod_security_level: kuberuntime: pod security level {level:%q}: want {restricted:%q} or {baseline:%q}
errors.proxy_only_needs_allow: kuberuntime: egress mode {mode:%q} needs the proxy in {env} (e.g. 10.0.5.20:3128, or the proxy pods' CIDR: NetworkPolicy matches pod IPs, not a Service's ClusterIP); a daemon HTTPS_PROXY given as an IP address is added automatically
errors.quota_full: the workspace has no room for this pod right now
errors.quota_too_small: the pod asks for more than the workspace's whole quota allows
errors.quota_too_small_detail: {cause}: {detail} (quota {quota}); raise the quota or size the pod down
errors.quota_race: another pod of the workspace was being admitted at the same moment
errors.rolebinding_wrong_role: kuberuntime: rolebinding {ns}/{name} points at {kind} {role:%q}, want ClusterRole {want:%q}; delete it and the next launch recreates it
errors.runtime_class_required: kuberuntime: {runtime_class_env} is not set, so agent and sandbox pods would share the node's kernel; set it to the cluster's sandboxed RuntimeClass (e.g. kata-clh), or set {allow_env}=1 on a dev cluster that has none
errors.teardown_workspace_required: kuberuntime: teardown needs a workspace id
errors.tenant_secrets_needs_sa: kuberuntime: {role_env} is set, so the daemon binds it in each tenant namespace and needs its own ServiceAccount: set {sa_env} (downward API spec.serviceAccountName) and {ns_env} (downward API metadata.namespace)
errors.worktree_claim_terminating: kuberuntime: worktree claim {ns}/{name} still terminating after {timeout}
errors.cache_size: kuberuntime: sandbox cache size {value:%q} ({env}): want a quantity like 20Gi, or off
errors.cache_size_negative: kuberuntime: sandbox cache size {value:%q} ({env}) is negative
errors.cache_claim_terminating: kuberuntime: cache claim {ns}/{name} still terminating after {timeout}
errors.quota_line_cpu: the workspace has {used} of {hard} CPU reserved and needs {requested} more
errors.quota_line_memory: the workspace has {used} of {hard} GiB of memory reserved and needs {requested} GiB more

image_build.auth_secret: could not read the registry credentials {ns}/{name}
image_build.base_unreadable: could not read {image} from its registry, so the daemon cannot tell how it installs Claude Code
image_build.job_create: could not start the image build Job {job}
image_build.job_wait: lost track of the image build Job {job}
image_build.no_label: {image} does not say how it installs Claude Code (built before the first-run install), so it is used as is
image_build.proxy_or_ca: agent traffic goes through a proxy or trusts an extra CA, which the image build does not pass to BuildKit; build the agent image with CLAUDE_CODE_INSTALL=build and set agentRuntime.imageBuild.enabled=false

log.image_build_failed: agent image build for {base} failed, agent pods keep installing Claude Code on first use: {reason}
log.image_build_skipped: agent image {base} is used as is: {reason}
log.image_build_started: building {image} from {base} (Job {job}); agent pods install Claude Code on first use until it is ready
log.list_nodes_failed: cannot list nodes, so tenant egress excludes only the private ranges and the {kept} node addresses known so far (grant the daemon's ClusterRole get/list on nodes): {err}
log.no_runtime_class: WARNING: no RuntimeClass ({allow_env}=1): agent pods run on the node's shared kernel, dev clusters only
log.own_pod_selector_mismatch: WARNING: this daemon pod ({pod}) lacks the label {label} from {env}, so tenant NetworkPolicies drop its connections to sandbox and chat exec agents; set {env} to labels this pod carries
log.secret_access_not_effective: rolebinding {ns}/{name} created but secret access not effective after {timeout}
log.set_secret_owner_failed: set owner of secret {ns}/{secret} to pod {pod}: {err}
log.sweep_deleted_stranded_pod: sweep: deleted agent pod {ns}/{pod}, Pending for {age} on claim {claim}, which no longer exists
log.sweep_deleted_pod: sweep: deleted exited agent pod {ns}/{pod} (finished {age} ago)
log.teardown_namespace_not_owned: teardown of tenant {tenant}: namespace {name} lacks {plane_label}={plane}/{tenant_label}={tenant}, not deleting it
log.tenant_secrets_unbound: {role_env} unset: not binding Secret access per tenant namespace; the daemon's ServiceAccount must already be allowed to write Secrets and ConfigMaps there
log.watch_pod_ends: watch Thulu pods ending (runs waiting for room retry on their timer instead)
log.reconcile_namespace_failed: bring namespace {ns} to the current labels: {err}
log.sweep_unlabeled_failed: sweep pods without current labels in {ns}: {err}
log.unlabeled_pod_removed: removed pod {ns}/{name} ({phase}): it carries no current label, an older release made it
